title: Degraded quality with partial coverage
purpose: Keep observation quality and coverage separate from pattern confidence.

expected.semantic_interpretation: The event remains an occurrence while its observation quality and coverage are degraded/partial.
expected.observability: Occurrence was observed, but evidence quality is degraded.
expected.opportunity: No opportunity claim is required for this fixture.
expected.time: Phenomenon, observation/result, and ingestion times remain distinct fields.
expected.provenance: Source identity and capture/procedure provenance remain explicit.
expected.raw_derived: Quality metadata describes evidence only and is not a pattern confidence score.
expected.lineage: No correction, deletion, or supersession is asserted.
expected.must_not_infer: Do not convert observation quality into pattern confidence or a recognition decision.
